abstract: The Society's published presidential addresses have embraced a wide range of subject matter, reflecting a ‘road well travelled’ in agricultural economics. The areas covered include the development and use of data and statistics, lessons from history, sectoral analysis, land economics, international trade and international development. There has been a major focus on the application of economic concepts to agricultural and agri‐environmental policy. The addresses also led to consideration of a number of important issues that go beyond the confines of technical analysis to a ‘road less travelled’. These issues include weaknesses in behavioural assumptions in economic theory, the challenge of objectivity in applied analysis, the limitations imposed by a static theoretical framework and the inadequacies of welfare economics in addressing distributional issues in policy choice. The addresses, spanning almost 100 years, demonstrate the role of agricultural economics in evidence‐based policymaking to address critical issues in the use of natural resources. The apparent rejection of the evidence‐based approach in some countries raises the question of whether humankind will be successful in finding a solution to the existential challenge posed by climate change.
abstract_zh: 学会发表的会长演讲涵盖了广泛的主题，反映了农业经济学中一条“走过之路”。涉及领域包括数据和统计的发展与应用、历史教训、部门分析、土地经济学、国际贸易及国际发展。重点在于将经济概念应用于农业和农业环境政策。这些演讲还引导了对若干超越技术分析范畴的重要问题的思考，即“未走之路”。这些问题包括经济理论中行为假设的弱点、应用分析中客观性的挑战、静态理论框架带来的局限性，以及福利经济学在处理政策选择中分配问题上的不足。这些跨越近一百年的演讲，展示了农业经济学在基于证据的政策制定中，对解决自然资源利用关键问题所起的作用。一些国家明显拒绝基于证据的方法，这引发了人类能否成功找到应对气候变化这一生存挑战解决方案的疑问。
title: Insights from the Presidential Addresses to the Agricultural Economics Society
title_zh: 农业经济学学会会长致辞的启示

abstract: In a two-period model of behaviour-based price discrimination, we consider the strategic incentives of competing oligopolistic firms in creating false expectations about the horizontal attributes of the products. In the case of exogenous real locations, we show that misleading advertising is profitable for firms as long as the equilibrium advertised product differentiation is greater than the real one. We also show that when firms adopt misleading advertising, behaviour-based price discrimination might increase the profits with respect to uniform pricing. When the real locations are endogenously chosen by firms, misleading advertising yields lower real product differentiation in equilibrium, but, due to the increase of the expected product differentiation, the final impact on the equilibrium profits is always positive. We also illustrate the implications of misleading advertising for consumer surplus and welfare, and we outline some policy prescriptions.
abstract_zh: 在行为性价格歧视的两期模型中，我们考察了竞争性寡头企业在制造关于产品水平属性的虚假预期方面的战略动机。在真实位置外生给定的情况下，我们证明，只要均衡广告中的产品差异化程度大于实际差异化程度，误导性广告对企业而言就是有利可图的。我们还表明，当企业采用误导性广告时，相对于统一定价，行为性价格歧视可能会增加利润。当真实位置由企业内生选择时，误导性广告在均衡中导致较低的真实产品差异化，但由于预期产品差异化的增加，对均衡利润的最终影响始终是正面的。我们还阐述了误导性广告对消费者剩余和社会福利的影响，并概述了一些政策建议。
title: Misleading Advertising and Customer Recognition
title_zh: 误导性广告与客户识别
